Name: Jabin, King of Hazor
Summary: Jabin was king of Hazor when he gathered the kings of the north against Israel at the waters of Merom.
KeyStory: Jabin's great host, with horses and chariots, was defeated by Joshua at Merom, and Hazor itself was burned with fire.
LifeLesson: Chariots and numbers are no answer to the LORD of hosts.
